reasons: The rule's fallback (and its summary) expressly require carve-outs for general advertising and unsolicited approaches; Section 13 has none, so the clause fails a material element of the fallback rather than a mere drafting nicety — a deviation classification is defensible.

The redline is the smallest edit that reaches the fallback: the existing mutual, involvement-limited, one-year, solicitation-based (non-no-hire) terms are left untouched and only the customary carve-out sentence is appended, matching the redline guidance.

Deterministic flags are not substantive here: the duration regex reports 'number not found' although the clause states 'one (1) year', and the 0.845 changed-character ratio reflects the length of a single appended sentence relative to a short clause, not a rewrite.
Comment is accurate, concise, first-person plural, correctly states what changed and cites the playbook position without lecturing.
